messages:
morgan: Heads-up — release branch CI is red after a lockfile regen. Integration job failing with 3 tests timing out in tests/integration/test_server_session.py. Stack shows AttributeError: 'SyncStream' object has no attribute 'aclose'. Suspect a transitive httpx/httpcore bump from the lock.
cheng: can repro locally with poetry env. After running tests I see httpx==0.24.1 and httpcore==0.16.0 in the venv.
sam: job logs (integration-py311) show the same. excerpt from the failing worker log attached inline:
```
E   AttributeError: 'SyncStream' object has no attribute 'aclose'
.../site-packages/httpcore/_sync/connection.py:142 in some_method
  return stream.aclose()
```
morgan: hmm, we used to call .aclose on async objects in an adapter; maybe httpcore surface changed for sync backend.
olivia: :eyes: could be the sync/httpx boundaries changed. We pinned httpx <0.24 in our requirements before — lock regen bumped it.
sam: quick idea: try temporarily pinning httpcore<0.16 in constraints and regen lock? Command I ran to reproduce locally:
```
poetry lock && poetry install --no-dev
pytest tests/integration/test_server_session.py -q
```
cheng: i ran git diff on the lockfile: new entries for httpx/httpcore and 'h11' bump too.
ci-bot: Rerun triggered by @morgan: /rerun integration-py311 (job 9876)
morgan: thanks. If rerun still fails, can someone volunteer to bisect the lockfile changes? I can do a quick revert but would prefer pinpointing the transitive.
cheng: I can run a bisect script. Plan: checkout release branch, then iterate through commits that touched poetry.lock to find the commit that introduced httpcore 0.16. I'll post results here.
sam: FYI, quick workaround for services: add a compatibility shim in our http adapter to guard for missing aclose and call close() instead. Not ideal but buys time.
olivia: For a cleaner fix, pinning httpcore<0.16 in the top-level constraints and running `poetry lock --no-update` should prevent the bump. Command:
```
# add to constraints.txt or pyproject[tool.poetry.dependencies]
httpcore = "<0.16"
poetry lock --no-update
```
morgan: okay, cheng please run bisect. If you find the offending dependency change I'll open an immediate PR to pin in pyproject and queue a lock regen.
cheng: starting now, will report back in ~30m. tagging @sam in case you want to craft the emergency shim PR.
morgan: thanks all. any other heads-up re: downstream services that might be impacted by httpx/httpcore changes?
sam: none noticed yet, only integration tests failing so far. keep an eye on dedupe-service tests.
ci-bot: Re-run finished: integration-py311 still failed (job 9876). Full logs: link to job 9876 logs.
morgan: ok committing to the PR path if bisect confirms. appreciate the quick triage :thumbsup:
